name: Dokploy
description: Self-hostable PaaS for deploying apps and databases (Next.js dashboard, Docker Swarm and Traefik).

install: cd apps/dokploy && npx tsx -r dotenv/config -e "const s=await import('@dokploy/server/setup/setup');const t=await import('@dokploy/server/setup/traefik-setup');await s.initializeNetwork();t.createDefaultTraefikConfig();t.createDefaultServerTraefikConfig();await t.initializeStandaloneTraefik();process.exit(0)"

db.cmd: docker start -a dokploy-postgres || docker run --name dokploy-postgres -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_USER=dokploy -e POSTGRES_DB=dokploy -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=amukds4wi9001583845717ad2 -v dokploy-postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16

web.cmd: pnpm --filter=dokploy run migration:run && pnpm run server:script && exec pnpm run dokploy:dev
